stories.title: Two protesters detained during pro-Palestine demonstration in Berlin
stories.summary: Two protesters detained during pro-Palestine demonstration in Berlin Police intervened in a pro-Palestinian demonstration in Berlin, Germany, detaining at least two people on Saturday, Reuters reported. A large number of pro-Palestinian protesters gathered at Ernst Reuter Square to protest Israel’s attacks on Gaza. Footage documenting arrests carried out by German police against several participants during a protest in Berlin in solidarity with Palestine. pic.twitter.com/7bedRHGDn2 — Eye on Palestine (@EyeonPalestine) September 5, 2026
